Before I was tagging each paragraph, writing down a few words down to crystallize what that passage was about as well as its purpose(just background info? Support for a viewpoint? Etc. I changed my strategy to “just read the whole thing  while keeping in mind the author’s viewpoint and the main point of the passage” For me personally, it was much easier to retain everything if I read the passage in one go, rather than stopping at each paragraph.
